clue.text: Be a subscriber?

parts.note: a subscriber is literally one who writes beneath, putting a name at the foot of a document, rather than a magazine buyer

explanation.surface: Someone wondering whether to take out a regular subscription.
explanation.definitionFit: To subscribe in its root sense is to sign at the bottom of a document, which is what this verb means.

clue.text: Rule over an ancient Scandinavian

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed over another comes first

parts.note: a rule or standard is a norm

explanation.surface: A ruler holding sway over some Viking of old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rule' looks like the verb governing the sentence, but it is a noun meaning a standard.
explanation.definitionFit: The Normans were Norsemen who settled in northern France, so the word once meant a Viking from Scandinavia.

clue.text: Point to French wine this also in France will reveal

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
vin is the French word for wine
ce is the French word for this

explanation.surface: Pointing to a French wine is said to reveal something about you.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a feeling is to show it plainly, a synonym of reveal.

clue.text: Excellent accepting cardinal as prime minister of New Zealand

indicators.note: the word for excellent takes in, accepts, the cardinal point within it

parts.note: swell is old slang for excellent
E, east, is one of the cardinal points of the compass

explanation.surface: A fine politician welcoming a churchman into the role of New Zealand's leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cardinal' looks like a churchman but is a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Sewell was the first premier of New Zealand, in 1856.

clue.text: Let out a secret and lose

definitions.meaning: to reveal what was meant to stay hidden
to throw a contest away, letting the opponent win

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both betraying a hidden plan and conceding a match through poor play.

clue.text: It needs three to complete the score

definitions.text: It needs three to complete the score

parts.words: It needs three to complete the score
parts.note: a score is twenty, so the number which is three short of twenty is wanted, not a musical or sporting score

explanation.surface: A team or composer needing three more to finish the score.
explanation.definitionFit: Seventeen plus three makes twenty, the number known as a score.

clue.text: Chips to go in after fish

indicators.note: the piece for going in is placed after the fish

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish
to enter is to go in

explanation.surface: Someone about to tuck into chips after a fish supper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chips' suggests fried potatoes, but it is the traditional nickname for a carpenter, from wood chips.
explanation.definitionFit: Chips is a long-standing nickname for a ship's carpenter or any woodworker.

clue.text: Reveal nothing of policy statement

parts.note: to manifest something is to reveal it
O, the round figure zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: A party declining to reveal anything about its policy statement.
explanation.definitionFit: A party's published declaration of intended policy is its manifesto.

clue.text: State Dane confused with Virginia shortly

indicators.note: the letters are confused, mixed up, into a new order

parts.note: VA is the short form of the state name Virginia

explanation.surface: A muddled Danish visitor mistaking one American state for Virginia.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is one of the fifty United States.

clue.text: Sudden bright idea might be recorded on an electroencephalograph?

definitions.meaning: an inspired thought arriving all at once

definitions.text: might be recorded on an electroencephalograph?
definitions.meaning: an electroencephalograph traces the electrical waves of the brain, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means an inspired notion, and literally names the brain's electrical oscillations that an EEG traces.

clue.text: Quietly in new Indian or old Greek city

indicators.note: the quiet letter goes in the Indian city's name

parts.note: New Delhi is the Indian capital, so the new Indian city is Delhi
p, piano, is the musical direction to play quietly

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a quiet place is a modern Indian city or an ancient Greek one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'city' serves the definition; 'new Indian' points to New Delhi, the Indian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Delphi was the ancient Greek town of Apollo's oracle.

clue.text: Work out the derivation of a cute call

indicators.note: a derivation is something formed from a source, so these letters are reworked into a new word

explanation.surface: A linguist tracing the etymology of a cute cry.
explanation.definitionFit: To calculate is to compute or reckon, synonyms of work out.

clue.text: Immediately performed one act

indicators.note: the letters are performed, acted out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A one-act play put on without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means straight away, without delay.

clue.text: Bring shame on a girl's integrity

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so a girl's is Di's
honour means integrity, moral uprightness

explanation.surface: A cad threatening to ruin a young woman's good name.
explanation.definitionFit: To dishonour someone is to disgrace them.

clue.text: A warning of course uttered beforehand

parts.note: fore is the golfer's shout of warning on a golf course
said means uttered

explanation.surface: A warning, naturally, given out in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' reads as 'naturally' but means on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: Aforesaid means mentioned earlier, said beforehand in a text.

clue.text: Showing off relative in the cast

indicators.note: the relative goes in the word for a cast

parts.note: a fling is a throw, a cast
an aunt is a relative

explanation.surface: An actor showing off because a relative is in the cast of the play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the cast' reads as a theatre company but is a throw, a fling.
explanation.definitionFit: Flaunting means parading or showing off ostentatiously.

clue.text: Black stream of liquid

definitions.meaning: a deep glossy black colour, as of the mineral
a forceful spurt from a nozzle

explanation.definitionFit: Jet black is the colour of the mineral, and a jet is also a gushing spout of water.

clue.text: Crowded mass on first June morning

indicators.note: the first letter of June is taken

explanation.surface: A crowd gathering early on the first day of June.
explanation.definitionFit: A jam is a dense crush of people or traffic.

clue.text: Attempt to be converted

definitions.meaning: an effort or go at something
in rugby a ... is touched down and then converted by a kick for extra points

explanation.definitionFit: A try is an attempt, and in rugby it is the score a kicker then converts.

clue.text: Unanimous that it should not be censored

definitions.text: that it should not be censored
definitions.meaning: agreeing that something should be shown complete, uncut

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means everyone agrees, and read whimsically it is agreeing that a text be given whole, uncut.

clue.text: Can be part of spring

definitions.meaning: a verb of permission, as in you can go
the last month of spring in the northern calendar

explanation.definitionFit: May grants permission like can, and it is also the late spring month.

clue.text: King brought before the authorities going round short of money

indicators.note: the phrase for being summoned goes round, encloses, the king's letter

parts.note: to be had up is to be summoned before a court or the police
R, rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A monarch hauled before the authorities for being broke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had up' is British slang for being brought to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard up is an idiom for being poor, lacking cash.

clue.text: Chancellor finds trademark on shirt

indicators.note: in a down clue, the trademark sits on top of the shirt letter

parts.note: a brand is a trademark
T as in T-shirt

explanation.surface: A finance minister spotting a logo on his shirt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chancellor' suggests Britain's finance minister; it is the German chancellor Willy Brandt.
explanation.definitionFit: Willy Brandt was Chancellor of West Germany from 1969 to 1974.

clue.text: Visitor has about everything returned

annotationWithheld.why: Visitor has about everything returned: C (about) + ALL (everything) gives CALL, but no clue word supplies the closing ER; 'returned' would need RE from 'about', which is already giving C

clue.text: Money often resisted

explanation.definitionFit: Change is loose coins, and change as alteration is what people commonly resist.

clue.text: Not pain but sorrow

parts.note: an ache of the chest organ would be physical pain, but the compound means grief instead

explanation.surface: A distinction between bodily pain and emotional sorrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartache is emotional anguish or grief, not a physical ailment.

clue.text: Critically discriminating with some of rowena's utensils

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are taken, a run spanning them

explanation.surface: A fussy diner judging a woman named Rowena's kitchen utensils.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasute, literally keen-nosed, means sharp-scented and so critically discerning.

clue.text: Sparkling for a very short time

definitions.meaning: an instant, as in the blink of an eye

explanation.definitionFit: Twinkling means glittering like stars, and in a twinkling means in an instant.

clue.text: More than one agreement between debating societies and workers groups

definitions.meaning: plural of an accord or marriage
university debating clubs such as the Oxford one

explanation.definitionFit: Unions are pacts or marriages, the Oxford and Cambridge debating societies, and trade associations of workers.

clue.text: Sleeping place for natives?

parts.note: natives are oysters raised in British waters, and their bed is the seabed where they lie

explanation.surface: Somewhere for local inhabitants to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'natives' is the trade name for British-bred oysters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed is where oysters are cultivated on the seabed, punning on a bed for sleeping.
